summary.goal: Main view during execution showing progress, tasks, and agents. The command center for monitoring a running forge execution.

acceptance_criteria.description: Progress bar with task counts (4/7 completed) and percentage
Task list with status icons: complete, running, pending, gate
Each task shows: title, duration, artifacts produced, dependencies
Active Agents section showing working agents
Run controls: Pause, Resume, Cancel buttons with confirmation
Real-time SSE subscription for live updates
Gate pending banner with link to approval UI
Elapsed time counter

observations: SSE provides task.started, task.completed, etc. events
Run controls call Forge API endpoints
useRun hook returns composite data shape for dashboard consumption
ASCII wireframe in design doc is the reference
Clear status indicators with color coding

hook_return_shape.useRun_returns: { run, tasks, activeGate, agents, elapsedMs, isLoading, error, refetch }
hook_return_shape.run: Full Run object with status, plan_id, etc.
hook_return_shape.tasks: Task[] - all tasks for this run
hook_return_shape.activeGate: Gate | null - currently pending gate if any
hook_return_shape.elapsedMs: number - calculated from run.started_at, updates every second for running runs

steps.title: Create RunProgress component
steps.description: Progress bar showing overall run completion

acceptance_criteria.description: Progress bar with fill animation (cyan accent color)
Text: 'X/Y tasks completed (Z%)'
Sub-text: elapsed time in HH:MM:SS format
Status indicator: 'Running' / 'Paused' / 'Complete' / 'Failed'

design.bar: h-2 bg-bg-tertiary rounded-full, fill with bg-accent-cyan

steps.title: Create TaskItem component
steps.description: Single task row in the task list

acceptance_criteria.description: Status icon: CheckIcon (complete), SpinnerIcon (running), CircleIcon (pending), GateIcon (awaiting_approval)
Task title with scope badge if multi-scope plan
Duration shown for completed/running tasks
Expandable to show: description, artifacts, dependencies
Status colors match design system: complete=green, running=cyan, pending=muted, gate=orange

specification.pattern_description: Collapsible item pattern with status indicator

design.layout: flex items-center gap-3 p-3 border-b border-border-subtle

steps.title: Create TaskList component
steps.description: Scrollable list of all tasks in the run

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders TaskItem for each task
Groups by scope if multi-scope plan (collapsible scope headers)
Auto-scrolls to currently running task
Handles empty state: 'No tasks in this run'

specification.pattern_description: Grouped list pattern with collapsible sections

acceptance_criteria.description: Pause button (visible when running)
Resume button (visible when paused)
Cancel button (always visible, with confirmation dialog)
Loading state on buttons during API call
Disabled when run is completed/cancelled/failed

specification.pattern_description: Action buttons pattern with confirmation dialogs

steps.title: Create GateBanner component
steps.description: Banner shown when a gate is pending approval

acceptance_criteria.description: Banner with warning icon and 'Gate pending approval' message
Shows task title of the gate step
Review button navigates to gate approval UI
Orange/warning color scheme
Hidden when no gates pending

design.layout: sticky top-0 z-10 bg-warning/10 border border-warning/30 rounded-lg p-4

steps.title: Create useRun hook
steps.description: Data fetching and SSE subscription for single run

acceptance_criteria.description: useRun(runId) returns { run, tasks, activeGate, agents, elapsedMs, isLoading, error, refetch }
Initial fetch via getRun API
SSE subscription for live updates
Updates local state on task_status_changed, run_status_changed events
Elapsed time counter (elapsedMs) updates every second for running runs
activeGate computed from tasks with status 'awaiting_approval'

specification.pattern_description: Combine fetch with SSE subscription pattern

data_shape.return_type: { run: Run, tasks: Task[], activeGate: Gate | null, agents: Agent[], elapsedMs: number, isLoading: boolean, error: Error | null, refetch: () => void }
data_shape.tasks: Task[] from API, updated via SSE events
data_shape.activeGate: Gate | null - computed from tasks where task.gate && task.status === 'awaiting_approval'
data_shape.agents: Agent[] - active agents for this run
data_shape.elapsedMs: number - Date.now() - Date.parse(run.started_at), updated every 1s via setInterval for running runs

steps.title: Create RunHeader component
steps.description: Header section with run info and controls

acceptance_criteria.description: Breadcrumb: Forge > Run [short-id]
Plan goal as title
RunProgress component
RunControls on the right side
Link to timeline view

specification.pattern_description: Similar header pattern with breadcrumb and actions

acceptance_criteria.description: Uses useRun hook to fetch and subscribe to run data
Renders RunHeader at top
GateBanner shown below header if has_pending_gate
Two-column layout on desktop: TaskList (main), ActiveAgents (sidebar)
Single column on mobile: TaskList above ActiveAgents
Loading state: skeleton for header and list
Error state: ErrorMessage with retry
Pause calls pauseRun(runId), updates local state on success
Resume calls resumeRun(runId), updates local state on success
Cancel shows confirmation dialog, calls cancelRun(runId)
Error toast on failure with message
Success toast on state change
